scientific_integrity: An analytic theorem with exact boundary-value construction and a reproducible independently discretized numerical checker; no independent scientific certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional constant-diffusivity circular geometry, one linear Markovian biased interface and fixed Borel reset law supported strictly in one semicircle.
Only the continuous-path membrane crossing current is counted; directional reset trajectories are not counted as membrane flux.
No classification for reset laws spanning both semicircles, nonlinear membrane transmission or reset laws changing with the rate.
Previously published biased-interface and symmetric reset-ring Green equations are credited; broader implicit theorem coverage is an originality risk.
title: One-sided resetting forces a unique permeability-independent current reversal at a biased membrane
